description:
§42.2.3 — inside a markup `${ … }`, a `given` head that is a comparison (`given @count > 0 :> {

…

}`) is not an identifier-list and SHALL be refused with E-SYNTAX-044 (exactly once), as in logic context. No W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED on a malformed head.
rationale: §42.2.3: "A `given` head SHALL contain only an identifier-list"; the refusal applies in both logic and markup-`${}` contexts (the E-SYNTAX-044 / E-SYNTAX-045 family is context-independent). Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a".
